svg.text: Verdicts after correction for serial persistence and false discovery across all tested basins. 2003–2024 annual values, Mann–Kendall with Sen slope.
Outlines simplified for drawing at 0.01° tolerance (91,106 → 20,739 points); values are not simplified.
Equirectangular with a cosine correction at the mid-latitude — a figure, not a projection to measure from.
